widgets_values:
A high-resolution, cinematic photograph captured with a professional DSLR, set inside a richly decorated, gothic-themed cafe interior, featuring a young East Asian woman in her early twenties, posed leaning slightly against a dark wooden entranceway, evoking a dramatic, romantic, and darkly alluring atmosphere reminiscent of vintage gothic portraiture.

The shot is framed as a medium close-up, slightly low angle looking up at the subject, which emphasizes her presence and height within the imposing architectural setting; the dark, ornate doorframe anchors the left side of the composition, contrasting sharply with the grand, dimly lit chandeliers visible deep in the background archway.

She is dressed in an elaborate black gothic Lolita style dress, characterized by voluminous ruffled layers, sheer black lace overlays on the sleeves, and a structured corset bodice featuring prominent lacing details; this is complemented by delicate black fishnet stockings and a choker necklace adorned with intricate black lace and small dangling charms.

Her hair is long, dark, and voluminous, styled with soft, deliberate waves that cascade over her shoulders, partially held back by a delicate, ornate black headpiece woven with subtle embellishments, appearing perfectly maintained yet naturally heavy with rich texture.

The subject possesses fair, porcelain-like skin with a warm undertone characteristic of East Asian complexions; the skin texture is rendered with hyperrealism, showing subtle pores and the gentle sheen of makeup highlighting the cheekbones, catching the ambient light softly across her décolletage.

Her large, expressive eyes are directed straight toward the viewer with a confident, inviting, yet slightly enigmatic smile, conveying a playful melancholy; the overall facial expression balances seductive allure with a sweet, knowing vulnerability.

The image suggests the use of a prime portrait lens, perhaps an 85mm, resulting in a shallow depth of field where the subject is razor-sharp while the background melts into a beautiful, atmospheric bokeh, providing separation without complete isolation.

There are no intentional lens artifacts such as significant dust spots or water droplets, but the deep shadows around the edges of the frame hint at vignetting inherent to wide aperture photography, adding to the moody confinement of the scene.

The film grain is fine but noticeable, particularly in the deep blacks of the velvet and wood, lending a tactile, slightly aged quality to the textures—the crispness of the lace contrasts beautifully with the soft diffusion of the shadows.

The color palette is dominated by deep blacks, rich mahogany browns, and muted jewel tones from the distant lighting fixtures; the rendering employs dramatic chiaroscuro, with warm, golden highlights selectively illuminating the subject’s skin and bust against the overwhelming darkness.

--ar 2:3

nodes.title: Note: Usage
widgets_values:
## Size
Qwen Image 2.1 has native 2K (2048*2048) support for direct output.

Output size comes from ResolutionSelector (width/height). Default is 1 megapixel (1024*1024). For native 2K, set 1:1 and 4 megapixels (2048*2048). Prefer multiples of 32.

## Transparent Image

To generate a transparent image, wrap the prompt like this and replace the middle with the subject:

---
This is an RGBA format image with transparency. `[your description]`. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.

---
Save as PNG to keep the alpha channel.

## Parameters

- prompt: what to generate. For RGBA, see Note: transparent.
- negative_prompt: unused while cfg is 1.
- cfg: keep 1 for the Qwen Image 2.1 official path. Raise it only if you use a negative prompt.
- steps: Qwen Image 2.1 official  pipeline uses about 40-50 with euler. This template starts at 25. More advanced samplers need fewer steps.

You are RawShot, a writer of raw, photorealistic sex photo prompts for Midjourney, Flux, Stable Diffusion, and other image models.Your only job is to turn the user’s request into the most direct, clear, detailed, and explicit prompt so the generated image matches what they want as closely as possible.Rules
Speak directly. No euphemisms. No pretty words in place of sexual acts.
State clearly who does what to whom, what pose, which body parts, saliva, semen, sweat, red marks, finger marks, or other dirty details when present.
Everyone in the image must be 18+. Always write a real numeric age in the prompt (e.g. 23-year-old Asian woman, 15-year-old man). Never use vague wording that could be read as underage.
If the user does not give an age, estimate it based on reality and put the age in the prompt.
Do not emphasize art, soft shadows, sheer curtains, or fashion-nude beauty.
Emphasize realism and rawness: amateur phone photos, harsh flash, grain, sweat, uneven skin, body hair, stretch marks, slightly sagging breasts, little or messy makeup, messy room, wrinkled sheets.
Analysis section in Thai. Image Prompt in English only.

Keep the prompt modular so one section can be swapped without repeating the rest.
Image Prompt (Copy & Paste):

[Short style prefix, e.g. Amateur smartphone photo, raw unedited candid snapshot, harsh on-camera flash, photorealistic, grainy, sweaty skin…]
CHARACTER:

[Each person separate: gender, numeric age, ethnicity, body, breasts/hips/genitals, skin, face, hair, body hair, expression. No vague age.]
CLOTHING:

[What remains, what was removed and where it lies, what is pulled/shifted/torn, wet, stained, or fully nude.]
POSE & ACTION:

[Direct poses and acts: who is squatting / kneeling / bent over / missionary / from behind / oral / penetration / hands / mouth / cum / spit / spreading, etc. Body positions, organs, movement.]
LOCATION / SETTING:

[Real place, time, light source, messy or clean background, objects, bed, sofa, bathroom, car, cheap hotel, etc.]
TECHNICAL & ATMOSPHERE:

[Phone or camera, front flash, grain, imperfect focus, slight shake, oily skin, pores, raw, unretouched — short, no repeat.]

nodes.title: Enhance Detail: how it works
widgets_values:
Turn on with the '✨ Enhance Detail (on/off)' switch.

Qwen Image 2.1 redraws the result in ~2 MP tiles, using each tile as a reference.
Restore 0.5 keeps it close, Detailer 0.75 adds fine detail, Viggle Turbo = 8 steps.
Text encoder and VAE are shared with the main workflow.

Megapixels: size of the enhanced image. About 1.6-2x per side works best.
More detail: Restore off, Detailer 1.0. Closer to the picture: Restore 0.75, Detailer 0.5.
Viggle Turbo = Qwen Research License (research use).

Note: Speed settings (ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel)
widgets_values:
## Speed settings (ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel)

Changes from the original: **⚡ Turbo = true** (Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo int8, 8 steps with the turbo sigmas, CFG 1),
the same model and schedule Paiton's Qwen-Image server runs; and **Text Encoder BF16** (ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel) after Load CLIP: the
Qwen3-VL encoder in bf16, encode 2.9 s → 0.4 s on a prompt change (a close variant of the fp32 picture, 27 dB).

Measured on the R9700 (220 W), warm, same prompt, new seed:

| | 1088x1920 | 1024x1024 |
|---|---|---|
| Base bf16, 25 steps (original) | 50.4-51.4 s | - |
| Turbo int8, 8 steps | 12.8 s | 5.2 s |
| **Turbo + bf16 encoder, prompt change** | **11.6 s** | - |
| Paiton (turbo, same sigmas) | - | 4.7 s |

The turbo model is 6.9 GB, so it stays in VRAM next to the 8.9 GB text encoder: no model swaps on prompt changes.
Turbo gives a different picture from the base model for the same seed, with the same prompt adherence and quality.

If you switch between base and turbo in one session, the first turbo run can run out of memory in VAE Decode while
the 13.5 GB base model is still loaded; run it again (ComfyUI unloads models after the error).

Note for this copy: the measured times above used a "Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1 (CFG 1)" node that skips the negative encode (not part of ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel). This copy uses the core Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1, so the text encode with reference images takes about twice as long. The picture is the same at CFG 1.
